描述_EN: the figure's head is movable. this is a figure of an attendant wearing a red hat, left hand raised to shoulder, standing on a hexagonal plinth, body made of pottery with green lead glaze. this type of earthenware figure was mass-produced to be buried with the deceased.
描述_ZN: 该人物的头部是可移动的。 这是一个戴着红帽子的侍者，左手举到肩上，站在一个六角形的基座上，身体是用绿色铅釉的陶器做的。 这种陶俑是大量生产的，与死者一起埋葬。
